brief: Move-in day. I work from home and want a calm living room where two friends can sit: something to sit on, a rug, a small table and warm evening light.

scan.summary: Nearly empty bright living room with large window, wood floor, two boxes and a rolled mat to clear.

dimensions_cm.basis: cardboard moving boxes about 40 cm cube and window span about 240 cm, typical ceiling 230 cm

light.direction: from large window on back wall

slots.look: compact 2-seat beige fabric sofa with low arms and clean modern shape

render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 7 are the reference photos of products 1 to 5, in order.
1. Add product 1: Beige Linen Loveseat Sofa (sofa), real size 170.2 x 96.5 x 88.9 cm (width x depth x height). Placed lengthwise against the left wall facing into the room. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Compact boxy two-seat loveseat in light beige linen with square arms, two loose back and seat cushions, and short tapered dark wood legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Add product 2: Cream geometric criss-cross rug (rug), real size 182.9 x 121.9 x 1.3 cm (width x depth x height). Laid flat on the floor in the center in front of the sofa. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular low-pile area rug in cream with subtle raised criss-cross geometric weave and soft woven wool texture. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: Glass Column Floor Lamp (floor lamp), real size 33 x 33 x 149.9 cm (width x depth x height). Stands on the floor in the back left corner beside the sofa end. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: Tall slender floor lamp with white drum linen shade, clear glass column on brushed nickel square base and metal stem. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
4. Add product 4: Round Traditional Coffee Table (coffee table), real size 96.5 x 96.5 x 48.3 cm (width x depth x height). Centered on the rug in front of the sofa, long side parallel to sofa. It belongs inside box 4 of the placement guide. Copy product 4 exactly from its reference photo: Round honey pine coffee table with thick wood top, four curved cabriole legs, and lower round shelf. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
5. Add product 5: Two-Tone Ceramic Planter with Stand (planter), real size 31 x 31 x 43.2 cm (width x depth x height). Stands on the floor on the right side under the window, clear of walkway. It belongs inside box 5 of the placement guide. Copy product 5 exactly from its reference photo: Cylindrical two-tone ceramic planter with white upper and speckled tan lower half sitting in a thin black iron four-leg stand. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Remove: cardboard moving box left; cardboard moving box right; rolled gray mat. Show the floor and wall that were behind them, continuing the surrounding texture, so it looks like they were never there.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
